# nb-speak

> `NB-Corp/nb-speak` (`v0.2.0`, MIT License) stops Personal Agents (`OpenClaw`, `AstrBot`, `Claude Code`, `Codex`, `skills.sh`, `Telegram`, `WhatsApp`, `WeChat`, `QQ`, `Feishu/Lark`, `Discord`, `Slack`) from turning chat windows into 250-word corporate memos and raw `|---|---|` Markdown pipe-table dumps. While prose humanizers (`humanizer`) edit essays, `nb-speak` enforces real mobile IM delivery physics through the `send_message` + `send_artifact` wire protocol, native **OpenClaw** (`@nb-corp/nb-speak-openclaw`) and **AstrBot** (`astrbot_plugin_nb_speak`) plugins, a zero-dependency OpenAI/SSE HTTP bridge, an interactive split-stage playground, deterministic TS/Python `bubble_lint` (`97.2%–100%` zero-slop pass rate), and the `chat-human` Agent Skill—delivering pure text short bubbles + clean code/table cards by default (`enableVoiceNotes: false`, with strictly opt-in generic TTS support).

## Quickstart Surfaces (Ordered by Developer Workflow)

1. `npx skills add NB-Corp/nb-speak --global --agent '*'` (or `npx skills add NB-Corp/chat-human`) — Install the standalone `chat-human` Agent Skill (`v0.2.0`) into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenClaw, Kiki, and 70+ `skills.sh` runtimes; Claude Code users can also install natively via `/plugin marketplace add NB-Corp/nb-speak` -> `/plugin install nb-speak@nb-corp`.
2. `npx --yes github:NB-Corp/nb-speak mcp` — Start the zero-dependency MCP (`Model Context Protocol`) `stdio` server (`@nb-corp/nb-speak-mcp`, official Registry ID `io.github.NB-Corp/nb-speak`, `server.json` + `glama.json` + `smithery.yaml`) for Cursor, Windsurf, Cherry Studio, Cline, Roo Code, Goose, LibreChat, LobeChat, Zed, and Raycast.
3. `npx --yes github:NB-Corp/nb-speak openclaw --apply` — Zero-clone installation of `@nb-corp/nb-speak-openclaw` (`openclaw.plugin.json`), adding `send_bubble` + `send_artifact` (`toolContext.delivery?.send`), `before_prompt_build`, and a deterministic `reply_payload_sending` / `message_sending` gate that fixes raw mobile pipe tables (`openclaw#36323`) and 250-word essay regressions on Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord, and Signal.
4. `https://github.com/NB-Corp/astrbot_plugin_nb_speak` & `https://github.com/NB-Corp/langbot_plugin_nb_speak` — Native **AstrBot v4+** (`astrbot_plugin_nb_speak`) and **LangBot v4+** (`langbot_plugin_nb_speak`) plugins for QQ, WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk, and Telegram, plus **Koishi** (`koishi-plugin-nb-speak`), **NoneBot2** (`nonebot-plugin-nb-speak`), **OpenWebUI** (`integrations/openwebui/nb_speak_filter.py`), and the OpenAI/SSE HTTP bridge (`nb-speak serve`).

## Documentation & Canonical Resources

- [Repository & Quickstart (English)](https://github.com/NB-Corp/nb-speak/blob/main/README.md): Personal Agent positioning, OpenClaw & AstrBot plugin guide, protocol spec, and `bubble_lint` rules.
- [中文文档 (README.zh-CN.md)](https://github.com/NB-Corp/nb-speak/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md): 面向 OpenClaw / AstrBot / 微信 / QQ / Telegram 的短气泡协议、防破功门禁与 30 秒接入指南。
- [OpenClaw Plugin Guide (`packages/openclaw-plugin/README.md`)](https://github.com/NB-Corp/nb-speak/blob/main/packages/openclaw-plugin/README.md): Native `openclaw.plugin.json`, `reply_payload_sending` table/code gate, and reversible `~/.openclaw` installer.
- [AstrBot Plugin Guide (`integrations/astrbot_plugin_nb_speak/README.md`)](https://github.com/NB-Corp/nb-speak/blob/main/integrations/astrbot_plugin_nb_speak/README.md): Native `Star` plugin (`metadata.yaml`, `_conf_schema.json`) for QQ, WeChat, Telegram, and Feishu.
- [Live IM Split-Stage Playground (EN / ZH)](https://nb-corp.github.io/nb-speak/): Interactive side-by-side comparison across 5 live scenarios, real-time `bubble_lint`, and offline Markdown-wall normalizer (`https://nb-corp.github.io/nb-speak/zh/`).
- [Full Technical Specification for LLMs (`llms-full.txt`)](https://nb-corp.github.io/nb-speak/llms-full.txt): Complete `send_message` + `send_artifact` schemas, PA plugin architecture, SSE wire format, `bubble_lint` error codes, and developer FAQ.
- [Standalone `chat-human` Skill Repository (`NB-Corp/chat-human`)](https://github.com/NB-Corp/chat-human): Universal 2-layer IM delivery & pluggable persona Agent Skill.
- [Sibling Ecosystem (`NB-Corp`)](https://github.com/NB-Corp): [nb-im](https://github.com/NB-Corp/nb-im) (multi-platform IM sessions), [nb-search](https://github.com/NB-Corp/nb-search) (unified search + RRF), [nb-extract](https://github.com/NB-Corp/nb-extract) (clean document-to-Markdown).
